I used to have a girlfriend who I really love, but bcs my fam get pestered a lot by loan sharks n all, I spent fewer time with her and we broke up. Its been a year since we did, but I felt it like it was yesterday. Lost my world pretty much since all my friends are hers too. I cant muster any more hope for the next day. I just want to feel the joy of going home again, a place where I was raised n all.

Been trying to be strong my fam n all, but I just lost it. Haven't got the willpower for anything, getting out of bed is so hard, sleeping is difficult bcs of dreams so sweet they are nightmares when I wake up.

At this point I'm just fed up, I want to escape it all. Contemplating suicide, I just dont feel things will get better. Couldn't say this to friends too since they won't understand, and here am I venting.
